projection.input_manifest: Retains exact bytes, SHA-256 and Git blob identities, replacing acquisition checkout paths with pinned public URLs. No source, runtime, scene or texture bytes are edited.
projection.scene_manifest: Camera and status descriptions state that GUI evidence is pending and not included; all fixture paths, hashes, poses and source identities are retained.
projection.blockbench_provenance: Retains application/source-map identity and only the five bundled source-map entries; paths are package-relative.
projection.omissions: One-time input collector, coordination queue, internal reports and redundant acquisition receipts are not public verification dependencies and are omitted.
projection.scripts: Numeric oracle and scene construction remain independent of production conversion. Public verifier adds package-local identity and path validation.
projection.fridge: Concise contract and selected exact source/license records accompany official API URLs. Acquisition paths and internal audit/report metadata are omitted.

trust_boundary: Hashes check package consistency and exact known input identities, not a signature or a fresh remote-source fetch. The verifier runs only bundled review code and a pinned official parseCube excerpt in a minimal data-only Node VM. It does not launch Blockbench, plugins, a native client or a network connection.
